# RoundFair

> RoundFair is a free iOS app that tracks whose turn it is to buy the next round on a night out, and splits the bill fairly at the end. Made by FairLead. No accounts, no analytics, no servers: data stays on the device and in the user's personal iCloud. Available in English, Dutch, French, German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone (iOS only). Price: free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6763799194
- Turn order: the "Up now" view shows who buys the next round and who is behind, based on the rounds each person has actually bought. A spin wheel can pick someone at random.
- Rounds are logged in one tap, with locations ("saved spots"). Restaurant mode splits itemised bills with tip and tax.
- Split the bill: settle at the end of the night; a consumption overview shows who drank what and the cost per person.
- Live sharing with the group through iCloud (CloudKit); works offline. The summary can be exported as plain text.
- Contact: roundfair@fairlead.be
